data.title: Adson-Brown forceps
data.summary: Forceps & clamps · Adson-type forceps whose tips carry two rows of many fine interlocking teeth, for delicate tissue.
data.body:
![Adson-Brown forceps](instruments/adson-brown-forceps.jpg)

_Also called: Brown-Adson forceps_

Adson-type forceps whose tips carry two rows of many fine interlocking teeth, for delicate tissue.

## Parts
- Adson-pattern handle
- Two rows of fine interlocking teeth at the tip

## Uses / indications
- Gentle handling of superficial, delicate tissue and skin edges

## How to hold
Hold like a pen with the first three fingers (between thumb and middle finger, index finger steadying); grasp dermis rather than epidermis to avoid crushing the wound edge.

## Sterilisation & care
Autoclave, hot air oven, 2% glutaraldehyde or boiling

## Viva points & tips
- Many small teeth spread the grip, so less crush than 1x2 teeth
